nodes.label: dissonancia shared library (C ABI)

nodes.label: dz_abi_check (-Wpadded -Werror)

nodes.label: Spec V2.3 (Real-Time Offline Music Analyzer)
nodes.rationale: Current target design; changes from V2.1: native desktop only, LIVE/POST strictly separated, modes fixed before session, no ASIO, MIT licence.

nodes.label: Spec V2.1 (original, historical)
nodes.rationale: Original spec kept for history; targeted Dear ImGui + WASM/Emscripten, superseded by V2.3 native C# desktop.

nodes.label: ABI layout check (static_assert + ana_struct_layout)
nodes.rationale: C# compares sizes/offsets at load and refuses to run on mismatch.

nodes.label: Bass preview + CQT confirmation
nodes.rationale: Two stages: low-latency YIN preview, CQT confirmation; uncertain bass never reports an inversion.

nodes.label: LIVE latency/CPU budgets
nodes.rationale: LIVE is visual feedback; ~40-60 ms visual lag is within A/V sync tolerance (ITU-R BT.1359), so sub-10 ms not needed.

nodes.label: Plain C ABI (extern C, POD, explicit padding)
nodes.norm_label: plain c abi (extern c, pod, explicit padding)
nodes.rationale: No alignas across ABI since C# cannot express it; padding holes explicit; C# pulls via ana_read_snapshot/ana_drain_events.

nodes.label: Harmonic-aware chord templates (180) + Occam penalties
nodes.rationale: Each chord note feeds its own partials; Occam penalties stop Cm6 reading as Adim and phantom sevenths.

nodes.label: Chroma with leakage removal
nodes.rationale: Removes -6.5 dB main-lobe neighbour leakage so a lone D does not light C#/D#; bass chroma kept separate from main chroma.

nodes.label: Computed settle time (settleSeconds = Q/f_min)
nodes.rationale: Never hard-coded; bassSettled false until elapsed since last onset.

nodes.label: CQT physics (T = Q/f, group delay T/2)
nodes.norm_label: cqt physics (t = q/f, group delay t/2)
nodes.rationale: Law not preference; drives minimum CQT frequency per mode and computed settle time.

nodes.label: Modes fixed before session, one pipeline per mode
nodes.norm_label: modes fixed before session, one pipeline per mode
nodes.rationale: No auto-detection or runtime switching: each adds analysis work and decision delay on the live path; unselected pipelines are not allocated.

nodes.label: Incremental milestone plan (M0-M11)
nodes.rationale: v1.0 = M0-M6 LIVE + fast path; no v1.x work before v1.0 acceptance is measured.

nodes.label: Key-aware spelling (letter/alter/written octave)
nodes.rationale: D-flat is not C-sharp; chromatic notes by melodic direction; octave follows the letter.

nodes.label: LIVE layer
nodes.rationale: Lowest latency visual feedback; provisional, cheap, deterministic, zero-allocation; never renders a score or writes files.

nodes.label: miniaudio capture (no ASIO in v1)
nodes.rationale: ASIO added only if measured WASAPI capture misses the <=20 ms budget.

nodes.label: Mode x quality configuration table
nodes.rationale: The only source of live settings: rate, window/T_low, hop, algorithm, range.

nodes.label: Never fake certainty
nodes.rationale: Insufficient evidence yields alternatives, reduced confidence or 'unknown'; ambiguities like C6=Am7 are flagged, never forced.

nodes.label: Bounded NNLS chroma (PGD, <=12 iterations)
nodes.rationale: Lawson-Hanson has unbounded convergence time causing frame jitter; deferred to M7c.

nodes.label: Analysis-thread notify rule
nodes.rationale: Callback wakes analysis only when >=1 hop unread and thread is waiting; avoids hundreds of useless futex wake-ups with small periods.

nodes.label: Physics wins principle
nodes.rationale: If a requirement conflicts with time-frequency resolution or filter group delay, report the conflict instead of pretending to implement it.

nodes.label: Placement rule (LIVE vs POST)
nodes.rationale: If a feature is expensive, optional, needs look-ahead or the whole recording, it belongs in STUDIO/SCORE, never LIVE.

nodes.label: POST layer (STUDIO/SCORE)
nodes.rationale: Accuracy over latency; may be slow and allocate; anything expensive, optional, needing look-ahead or whole recording belongs here.

nodes.label: Real-time threads never call managed code
nodes.norm_label: real-time threads never call managed code
nodes.rationale: GC pauses only managed threads; C# pulls snapshots/events instead of native callbacks.

nodes.label: RealtimeSanitizer + operator new trap
nodes.rationale: Mandatory verification: any allocation/lock in callback or steady-state loop fails CI.

nodes.label: SessionConfig
nodes.rationale: Immutable after ana_start; changing any option means a new session.

nodes.label: Source separation (Demucs v4 via demucs.cpp)
nodes.rationale: STUDIO only; slow, cancellable, every stem carries a confidence.

nodes.label: STUDIO stage pipeline (0-8) with stage cache
nodes.norm_label: studio stage pipeline (0-8) with stage cache
nodes.rationale: Each stage cached by hash of options + upstream; changing an option reruns only downstream.

nodes.label: Tonal context / cadence prior
nodes.rationale: Weight 0.06, below two Occam penalties: context decides only what audio leaves open.

nodes.label: Triple-buffer LiveSnapshot (lossy state)
nodes.rationale: Latest wins; never carries events; POD with inline arrays, no pointers.

nodes.label: V2.1 WASM + Dear ImGui stack
nodes.rationale: Dropped in V2.3 in favour of native C++ core + C# Avalonia.

nodes.label: Verovio score rendering (LGPL, dynamically linked)
nodes.rationale: LGPL-3.0 kept as separate dynamic library to preserve MIT licensing; SCORE only, never LIVE.

nodes.label: VST3 hosting (out-of-process PluginHost)
nodes.rationale: Never in LIVE: plugins may allocate/lock; out-of-process so crashing plugins never take the app down; milestone M11.

nodes.label: Zero-allocation C# render loop
nodes.rationale: SustainedLowLatency only avoids Gen2 blocking; Gen0/1 still run if anything allocates, so TryFormat into preallocated spans.

nodes.label: Zero allocation in real-time paths
nodes.rationale: No malloc/new/vector resize/string in audio callback or analysis steady-state loop; prevents xruns and nondeterminism.

nodes.label: Onset-gated low-octave windows
nodes.rationale: Previous chord's bass must not contaminate the new chord; bins excluded until their window refills.

nodes.label: Onset detection (spectral flux over CQT)
nodes.rationale: Reuses CQT magnitudes at marginal cost; 80 ms refractory.

nodes.label: Melodic note tracker (median-of-3, hysteresis)
nodes.rationale: Vibrato never creates a new note; instantaneous pitch every hop for tuner, stabilized pitch for score.

nodes.label: Pipeline A - Voice (YIN)
nodes.rationale: YIN on unwindowed frame (windowing biases d(tau)); one estimator live, MPM cross-check only in POST.

nodes.label: Resolution vs estimation
nodes.rationale: Resolving semitone-apart tones needs ~1/df (200 ms at 82 Hz); estimating one tone needs only 2-3 periods, so bass preview uses estimation and CQT confirms.

nodes.label: Arpeggio accumulator (decaying max-hold)
nodes.rationale: Used only on sparse frames so strummed changes are never smeared.

nodes.label: Chord tracker (preview vs confirmed, 0.4-1 s)
nodes.rationale: Confirmation delay is documented behavior; passing tones never confirm.

nodes.label: Event completeness rule
nodes.rationale: Score consumes only complete NoteEnd/ChordEnded events, so a dropped event loses one note but never creates a stuck one.

nodes.label: Event backdating / round-trip latency compensation
nodes.rationale: Bar grid is where the click is generated; a note on the beat arrives after output+input latency, so subtracting input only leaves notes late.

nodes.label: LIVE -> SCORE fast path
nodes.rationale: Confirmed LIVE event log sent to stages 5-8 with no audio reprocessing; results in seconds.

nodes.label: Metronome on input sample clock
nodes.rationale: Output device crystal drifts ~50 ppm; recorded grid never taken from output clock.

nodes.label: REC take (WAV + JSON sidecar)
nodes.rationale: REC requires metronome with count-in so bar grid is exact for the LIVE->SCORE fast path.

nodes.label: SPSC EventQueue with sequence numbers (lossless)
nodes.rationale: Capacity 4096, try_push only; sequence gaps reveal drops.

nodes.label: Global tuning estimation (11 kernel sets)
nodes.rationale: Median of many peak deviations; never change tuning based on a single note; switching sets avoids allocation.

nodes.label: Polyphase IIR all-pass half-band decimation
nodes.rationale: Magnitude CQT ignores phase; ~4 ms cascade delay vs ~19 ms for a 31-tap FIR cascade.

nodes.label: Integer-ratio decimation of native rate
nodes.rationale: No arbitrary-ratio resampler on live path; sample rate is not a latency lever since window is set by lowest period.

nodes.label: Multi-resolution octave-decimated CQT
nodes.rationale: Only top octave at full rate; lower octaves decimated by 2. Direct dot product per bin beats per-octave FFTs at live sizes (4x faster than full-rate).
